'''Tyler Nafziger''' (also published as '''Tyler Naziger''')<ref name="dt-15833">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15833 DeckTech post 15833], DeckTech (david "rota" fairbanks, 8 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15833/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15833/ GitHub Pages].</ref> posted a [[Dark]] [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]] list on DeckTech in May 2001. He played at the [[August 2000 Normal tournament]] on 3 August 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to David Marincic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1101">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-normal-il-8-3-00d1101/ normal-il-8-3-00], DeckTech (David "Wedge659" Marincic, 7 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-normal-il-8-3-00d1101/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
